intro.title: Floral art, a story of passion
intro.description: Boticia is a floral design studio that brings your ideas to life through personalised floral scenography. Whether for a wedding, an artistic project or enhancing your hotel or restaurant, we create lasting floral compositions that elevate your events and reflect your vision, using only seasonal flowers.

creations.chapter_bouquets_desc: The centrepiece of your outfit, the bridal bouquet is created for you, in harmony with your dress, your style and your personality. Asymmetric, round or deconstructed, every style is possible.
creations.chapter_ceremonie_desc: Floral arch, flower-lined aisle, altar arrangements: your ceremony venue, civil, religious or symbolic, becomes a unique botanical setting.
creations.chapter_reception_desc: Centrepieces, hanging installations, cocktail and buffet decor: every table and every space is dressed to create a cohesive, immersive atmosphere.
creations.chapter_accessoires_desc: Buttonholes, flower crowns, combs and wrist corsages: delicate creations for the bride, the groom, the witnesses and the bridesmaids.
creations.title: Our wedding work
creations.subtitle: Bridal bouquets, ceremony and reception decor: a glimpse of the weddings Boticia has brought to bloom, in Provence and Paris.
creations.intro_p1: Every wedding starts with a conversation. We talk about your style, your venue and your wishes, then design bespoke floral decor, unique and thought through down to the last detail.
creations.intro_p2: We work with seasonal flowers, mostly from local growers. A personalised floral book lets you picture your decor before the big day, and we take care of creation, installation and removal on site.
creations.details_title: From the bridal bouquet to the reception
creations.personal_desc: Bridal bouquet, buttonholes, flower crowns and hair flowers: delicate creations, matched to your outfit and personality.
creations.ceremony_desc: Floral arch, flower-lined aisle, altar arrangements: your ceremony venue, civil, religious or symbolic, becomes a botanical setting.
creations.reception_desc: Centrepieces, hanging installations, cocktail and buffet decor: every space is dressed for a cohesive, immersive atmosphere.

weddings.title: Wedding floral design
weddings.intro: Personalised floral guidance, from designing bridal bouquets to floral scenography, for a bespoke, distinctive wedding decoration considered down to the smallest detail.
weddings.step_1_desc: During a video call, we get to know each other and discuss your wishes for your wedding. This exchange helps us understand your world, your tastes and your vision for the big day to translate your floral desires.
weddings.step_2_desc: You receive a detailed quote, adapted to your budget, accompanied by a moodboard to illustrate your floral world and help you envision the atmosphere of your wedding.
weddings.step_3_desc: A personalised floral book: a selection of seasonal flowers, a personalised colour palette and visual projections of your decoration and floral arrangements. This service includes the creation, installation and removal of your floral decoration at the venue.
weddings.cta_title: Ready to imagine your floral wedding?
weddings.cta_desc: Tell us about your project and we will design a floral decoration that is uniquely yours.
weddings.services_title: Every floral detail, designed for you
weddings.services_intro: From personal flowers to grand installations, every element is handpicked and handcrafted with seasonal French flowers.
weddings.service_bouquet_desc: The centrepiece of your outfit, the bridal bouquet is created especially for you, in harmony with your dress, your universe and your personality. Asymmetric, round, deconstructed: every style is possible.
weddings.service_ceremony_desc: Floral arch, flower-lined aisle, altar compositions. We transform your ceremony venue · civil, religious or symbolic · into a unique green setting.
weddings.service_reception_desc: Table centrepieces, floral arrangements, hanging florals, buffet décor. Every table and space is dressed to create a cohesive, immersive atmosphere.
weddings.service_accessories_desc: Boutonnieres, flower crowns, combs, bracelets. Delicate creations for the bride, groom, best men and bridesmaids.
weddings.why_title: A wedding florist who understands you
weddings.why_1_desc: We work mostly with local growers in short supply chains. Your arrangements are sustainable and seasonal.
weddings.why_2_desc: From the first meeting to installation on the day, you have a single point of contact who knows your project inside out.
weddings.why_3_desc: Follow your project in real time: collaborative moodboard, detailed proposals and streamlined communication in your private space.
weddings.why_4_desc: Based in Provence, we serve the entire PACA region and travel throughout France for your wedding.
weddings.faq_1_q: What budget should I plan for wedding floral decoration?
weddings.faq_1_a: For a personalised floral decoration including the ceremony decor, accessories and installation, budgets start from €4,000. We tailor every proposal to your budget.
weddings.faq_2_q: How far in advance should I book?
weddings.faq_2_a: We recommend contacting us 8 to 12 months before your wedding, especially during peak season (May to October). For weekday or off-season weddings, 4 to 6 months is sufficient.
weddings.faq_3_a: Absolutely. We work with you to identify varieties that match your vision. Some flowers are seasonal · we will suggest the best alternatives if your favourite isn't available on your wedding date.
weddings.faq_4_a: Yes, we travel throughout France. Travel fees apply beyond the PACA region. Contact us for a personalised quote including transport and installation.

events.title: Event florist · floral scenography
events.intro: Floral scenography for your professional and private events. We transform your spaces into unique visual experiences through flowers.
events.service_1_desc: Complete artistic direction for your parties, launches, and galas. Floral creations that reflect your identity.
events.service_2_desc: Transform your offices, storefronts, and reception areas into inspiring spaces with bespoke floral arrangements.
events.service_3_desc: Boticia offers weekly or fortnightly floral subscriptions for hotels, restaurants and boutiques. Bespoke floral creations made with seasonal French flowers, delivered and arranged in your venue.
events.service_4_desc: Floral design for your editorial, photographic, and artistic projects. From concept to completion.
events.philosophy_p1: Boticia offers weekly or fortnightly floral subscriptions to hotels, restaurants, boutiques and reception venues. Each creation brings a distinctive floral signature, in harmony with your venue's identity. Together we define your wishes and how often the flowers are renewed, then create bespoke arrangements with seasonal French flowers, including delivery and installation.
events.gallery_desc: Each floral arrangement is designed to reflect your vision and add a unique touch to your events and professional spaces.
events.cta_desc: Describe your project and we will design the floral scenography that leaves a lasting impression.
events.why_1_desc: Every project benefits from a unique artistic direction, designed to reflect your identity and elevate your event.
events.why_2_desc: We work with seasonal flowers, more than 60% of them grown locally in short supply chains, for unrivalled freshness and quality.
events.why_3_desc: A single point of contact guides you from concept to installation, ensuring seamless coordination on the day.
events.why_4_desc: We handle the full logistics: delivery, installation, and collection of materials after your event.
events.faq_1_q: How far in advance should I book floral scenography?
events.faq_1_a: We recommend getting in touch at least 4 to 6 weeks before your event. For large-scale projects (galas, launches), 2 to 3 months is ideal to refine every detail.
events.faq_2_q: Do you offer services for businesses?
events.faq_2_a: Yes, we work with businesses on corporate events: seminars, product launches, gala evenings, office and storefront decoration. We also offer regular floral subscription services.
events.faq_3_a: Absolutely. We create floral installations both indoors and outdoors: gardens, terraces, castle courtyards, private beaches. We adapt our designs to the venue constraints.
events.faq_4_a: It all starts with a conversation about your project. We then present a moodboard and detailed quote. Once approved, we design and install your floral decor on the day of the event.

workshops.title: A creative moment with flowers
workshops.intro: Discover floral art in a hands-on workshop led by Laetitia. Leave with your own creation and a smile.
workshops.type_1_desc: Learn to arrange a bouquet with fresh seasonal flowers, grown in France.
workshops.type_2_desc: Create a decorative dried flower wreath to hang in your home for years to come.
workshops.type_3_desc: Compose a lasting, poetic arrangement with carefully selected dried flowers.
workshops.audience_desc: Whether it's team bonding, celebrating with friends or marking a special occasion, our workshops adapt to your wishes.
workshops.audience_teambuilding_desc: Strengthen team bonds through a creative and friendly floral activity.
workshops.audience_evjf_desc: A unique moment with friends to celebrate the bride-to-be by creating together.
workshops.audience_birthday_desc: Gift an original and memorable experience for a birthday celebration.
workshops.audience_private_desc: A bespoke workshop for your receptions, family gatherings or intimate moments.
workshops.cta_desc: Get in touch to organise a bespoke workshop for your group.

features.title: Floral design crafted for your events
features.feature_1_description: We favour seasonal flowers, over 60% locally sourced, to ensure optimal freshness while reducing our environmental impact.
features.feature_2_description: Every floral arrangement is unique, designed and handcrafted to match your vision, theme and venue.
features.feature_3_description: Sustainable practices at every step: seasonal flowers, a mindful approach, reusable supports.

pricing.title: All-inclusive packages for your wedding
pricing.plan_2_summary: Bridal bouquet, boutonnieres, table centrepieces, welcome sign and venue visit included. Everything you need for a complete and harmonious floral decoration.
pricing.plan_3_summary: Complete artistic direction, bespoke scenography, setup and day-of coordination. For those who dream of an exceptional floral event.

process.title: Three steps to your floral decoration
process.step_1_description: We discuss your project, your wishes and your world during a free, no-obligation first meeting.
process.step_2_description: We design a bespoke proposal with a moodboard, a floral palette and a detailed quote tailored to your budget.
process.step_3_description: Our team carefully installs each arrangement to enhance your venue and create the atmosphere you've been dreaming of.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our floral services.
faq.q1: How far in advance should I book?
faq.a1: We recommend reaching out 6 to 12 months before your event, especially for weddings during peak season (May to October).
faq.q2: Do you work with seasonal flowers?
faq.a2: Yes. We work with seasonal flowers, more than 60% of them grown locally in short supply chains, for unrivalled freshness and quality. Depending on your wishes, we can thoughtfully incorporate select imported varieties.
faq.a3: Yes, we travel across all of France for your events. Travel fees may apply depending on the distance.
faq.q4: How does a first consultation work?
faq.a4: Get in touch by email or phone. We discuss your project, your wishes and your budget during a free, no-obligation first meeting.
faq.q5: Where and how are the creations made?
faq.a5: All compositions are assembled to order in our studio in Provence, with the utmost care.
faq.q6: How long do dried flower bouquets last?
faq.a6: Dried flowers stay intact for several months, even years, as long as they are kept away from direct sunlight and moisture.
faq.a7: Yes, Boticia supports you throughout your wedding with bespoke floral creations: bouquets, arches, centrepieces and much more.
faq.q8: Can you create custom floral decorations for events?
faq.a8: Every event is a bespoke service tailored to your needs: floral scenography, flower corners, suspended installations.
faq.q9: How should I care for dried flower arrangements?
faq.a9: Keep your bouquets away from direct sunlight and avoid humidity, draughts and heat sources to preserve their beauty.
faq.q10: What types of workshops do you offer?
faq.a10: We offer bouquet composition, flower wreath, terrarium and seasonal creation workshops, for all levels and occasions.
faq.cta_title: Have a question not listed here?
faq.cta_desc: Get in touch directly, we'd love to help.

connexion.title: Signing in
connexion.summary: No password: each time you sign in, you get a code by email.

steps: Open the sign-in page of the website.
Type your email address, then click “Continue”.
Open the email “Votre code de connexion”.
Type the 6-digit code. The dashboard opens.

blocks.tip: No code? Check your spam folder. You can also click “Resend code”.

blocks.p: Your clients sign in to their client space the same way, with the email address of their request.

tableau-de-bord.title: The dashboard home
tableau-de-bord.summary: The first page after you sign in. It shows your requests and what needs your attention.

list: “My quotes”: your requests. Click a request to open it. The “My quotes” title opens the full list, with a filter by status.
“Alerts”: requests that need an action from you. For example, a quote sent several days ago with no reply.
“Site photos”: the photo library and the photos of each page.
“Reviews”: the testimonials on the home page.
Your meeting slots.
Personalization: the logo and the ambiance color of the website.
This guide.
Updates: what's new in the dashboard.
Sign out.

parcours.title: The life of a request
parcours.summary: A request goes through 7 steps, from the form to the event. Several happen on their own.

steps: The client fills in the quote form and picks a meeting. You have nothing to do.
You have the discovery call. The next day, the request moves to “Contacted” on its own.
You send a moodboard from the request page.
You send the quote. The request moves to “Quote sent” on its own.
The client approves the quote, or writes to you.
No reply? You get a reminder 2 days later.
You change the status yourself: “Project confirmed”, then “Completed”.

blocks.tip: Each step has its own article in the contents, with the details.

statuts.title: Request statuses
statuts.summary: The status shows where a request stands. 3 statuses change on their own. You choose the other 3.

blocks.p: To change a status: open the request, then choose the new status.

blocks.tip: When the client approves the quote, the status does not change. Set the request to “Project confirmed” yourself once the project is confirmed.

formulaire.title: The quote form
formulaire.summary: The “Request a quote” page of the website. The client answers one question at a time.

steps: The category: Wedding, Business & events, or Floral workshop.
Her needs. For example, for a wedding: bridal bouquet, ceremony arch, centerpieces.
Her name.
Her email and phone number.
Her project: the type of event, the date, the venue and the number of guests.
Her budget.
Her inspiration photos. She can also add them later.
A slot for the discovery call, chosen from your availability.
A summary, then she sends it.

blocks.p: In “Business & events”, the client can choose “Floral subscription”. These are flowers delivered on a regular basis, for example for a hotel, a restaurant or a boutique.
The monthly budget of a subscription is set during the discovery call.

list: A request is created in the dashboard, with the status “New request”.
You get an email. Its button opens the request, without signing in again.
The client gets an email with a link to her client space.

rendez-vous.title: Meetings and your slots
rendez-vous.summary: The client picks her own discovery call, from the slots you open.

steps: Click ⚙️, top right.
In “Recurring slots”, add your weekly slots: the day, the start time, the end time and the length of a meeting.
In “Exceptions”, block a date, for example for a holiday. You can also add an extra slot.

blocks.p: On the request page, click “Change the slot”.

blocks.tip: The day after the meeting, the request moves to “Contacted” on its own.

moodboard.title: Sending a moodboard
moodboard.summary: A moodboard is a board of images. It shows the client the mood you imagine for her project.

steps: Open the request.
Under “Moodboard”, click “Add”.
Drop the images or a PDF.
Write a note for the client, if you wish.
Save the draft.
When everything is ready, click “Send version 1”.

list: The client gets the email “Votre moodboard floral est prêt”.
She finds the moodboard in her client space. Your note shows under “A note from Laëtitia”, in her space and in the email.
Each send creates a fixed version: V1, V2… Earlier ones stay in the history.
The request status does not change.

devis.title: Sending a quote
devis.summary: The quote is a PDF you add to the request. The client reads it and approves it in her client space.

steps: Open the request.
Under “Quote”, click “Add”.
Choose the PDF of the quote.
Write a note for the client, if you wish.
Save the draft.
Click “Send version 1”.

blocks.tip: A draft stays with you. Until you click “Send”, the client receives nothing. An alert reminds you on the dashboard home.

list: The client gets the email “Votre devis floral est disponible”.
Your note shows in the email, in a box “A note from Laëtitia”. It also shows in her client space. With no note, the box does not appear.
On the first send, the request moves to “Quote sent” on its own.
Each new send creates a version: V1, V2… Earlier ones stay in the history.

reponses.title: Client replies and reminders
reponses.summary: The client approves the quote, or writes to you. If she does not reply, the site sends you a reminder.

list: She clicks “Accept proposal”, or “Write to Laëtitia”. She can write as many times as she likes.
You get an email each time. It contains the client's message.
Each message shows in the history of the request.
An approved quote is marked “Quote approved”. The request status does not change: set it to “Project confirmed” yourself.
The client opened her quote, but did not approve it or write to you? You get a reminder in the morning, 2 days later.
You get only 1 reminder per quote version.
The reminder is never sent on Saturday or Sunday. It arrives on Monday instead.
The reminder's button opens WhatsApp, with a message already written for the client.

emails.title: Automatic emails
emails.summary: The site sends 8 emails on its own: 4 to you, 4 to the client.

blocks.p: Emails to the client are sent in her language: French, English or Japanese.

blocks.tip: When you write a note with a moodboard or a quote, it is copied into the client's email, in a box “A note from Laëtitia”. Read it again before sending.

espace-client.title: The client space
espace-client.summary: Each client has her own space on the website. She follows her project there.

list: Her inspiration photos. She can add more at any time.
The moodboard and your note.
The quote, which she can approve.
The “Write to Laëtitia” button.
Her space opens as soon as she sends her request.
The link in her confirmation email takes her straight there.
After that, she signs in with her email. She gets a 6-digit code, with no password.

photos.title: The photo library
photos.summary: All your photos, in one place. You upload a photo once, then place it on the pages you choose.

steps: Open “Site photos”, “Photo library” tab.
Click “Upload photos”, then choose them.
Pick their type: Wedding, Business or Workshop. This is optional.
Give a collection name, if you wish. This is optional too.
Click “Add”.

blocks.p: The type helps you find your photos. For example, when you fill the Weddings page, you see the wedding photos first.
Each photo has only one type. To change it, choose another type under the photo.
A collection groups the photos of one event. For example: “Sophie and Paul's wedding, Château de la Gaude”.

list: When uploading, type a new name, or choose a collection that already exists.
The “Collection” filter shows only its photos. It is also in the “Choose a photo” window.
Under each photo, “Change” moves it to another collection, or removes it from its collection.
When a collection is shown, you can rename it or delete it.
Deleting a collection does not delete any photo.

blocks.tip: A photo is in only one collection. Its photos can have different types.

blocks.h: See where a photo is used

blocks.p: Under each photo, a line shows the pages where it appears. For example: “Shown on the site, Home and Weddings pages”.

list: Click “Delete” under the photo.
If the photo is on the website, it is removed from the pages. Its slot stays empty.
Deleting is final.

photos-pages.title: Placing photos on the pages
photos-pages.summary: Each tab of “Site photos” shows a page of the website, with its slots. Click a slot to choose its photo.

steps: Open “Site photos”.
Choose the page's tab: Home, Portfolio, Weddings, Business & events or Floral workshop.
Click a slot.
Choose a photo from the library. The label “✓ Already on the site” marks a photo already in use.
The photo shows on the website right away. The “View the page” button lets you check.

list: Home: a grid of 9 photos, then extra photos in the viewer.
Portfolio: a large opening photo, then 4 chapters of up to 2 photos. The chapters are: Bridal bouquets, Ceremony decor, Reception floral scenography, Floral accessories.
Weddings: a grid of 9 photos, then the viewer.
Business & events: a grid of 9 photos, and the 2 photos of the “Floral subscription” section.
Floral workshop: 3 photos side by side.
On the website, a click on the grid opens the viewer. It shows the 9 photos, then the extra photos.
The last slot of the grid shows how many there are. For example, “+3” for 3 extra photos.
Fill the 9 slots of the grid first. You can then add photos to the viewer.

blocks.tip: To empty a slot, open it, then click “Remove the photo”. For the floral subscription, a default photo then shows instead.

legendes.title: Photo captions
legendes.summary: A caption describes the photo in one sentence. It helps Google understand your photos.

blocks.p: The caption also helps blind people: their computer reads it out loud.

steps: Open “Site photos”.
Under a photo, click “+ Add a caption”.
Write one sentence, then click “Save”.

list: Give the type of creation, the flowers, and the place if you know it.
Example: “Bridal bouquet, peonies and garden roses”.
Example: “Ceremony floral arch, Château de la Gaude”.
200 characters at most.

blocks.tip: A photo keeps the same caption on every page. At the top of each tab, a counter shows the photos with no caption.

avis.title: Reviews
avis.summary: Your clients' testimonials, shown on the home page of the website.

steps: Open “Reviews” from the dashboard home.
Click “Add a review”.
Write the review in French. English is optional.
Add the name and a detail, for example “Wedding in Provence”.
Turn on “Show on the website”, then save.

list: For the name: the first name and an initial, like “Sophie M.”. It is more discreet.
Keep 1 or 2 strong sentences. Quotation marks are added on their own.
With no English text, the English and Japanese versions of the site show the French.
“Move up” and “Move down” change the order of the reviews on the website.
A “Hidden” review is off the website, but it is not deleted.

personnalisation.title: Logo and ambiance color
personnalisation.summary: The Personalization page sets the logo and the shade of the light backgrounds of the website. Open it from the ⚙️ button.

list: It shows at the bottom of every page of the website and on the sign-in page.
Accepted formats: PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG.
Recommended: a transparent background, and at least 512 pixels wide.

blocks.p: It is the shade of the light backgrounds: banners, cards, footer. It changes on every page of the website.

blocks.tip: The 2 floral subscription photos are no longer set here. They are in “Site photos”, “Business & events” tab.
